sourceObservation.method: Fresh official UI selector choices under source-year 2025 football and basketball, including all brands/programs; Download Full Checklist clicked for each of 12 missing programs. Exact UTF-8 data:attachment/csv DOM payloads retained without changing any original field or whitespace. Each program used a reloaded checklist page to avoid stale export reuse. Product/source year, checklist first observation and release date remain separate.

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 8,879 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-21; that observation is not a release date. Printed card-set identities naming other products are retained. Full product-guide and calendar-release reconciliation remain pending.
